# Notes.ThatVetGuy

> Free academic resources, thoughtfully made for future vets.

A free academic library for BVSc & AH students. Site summaries: Dr. Chirag Patidar, BVSc & AH, MVSc. Notes, books and practical material are organised by professional year and subject. File links open on Google Drive. Known source credits are preserved; inclusion does not imply authorship or medical review.

Main website: https://thatvetguy.net
Author: Dr. Chirag Patidar
Last source review: 2026-10-18. File access settings can change.

## Sections and subject guides

- [Free Veterinary Notes, Books & Study Resources | ThatVetGuy](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/): Free academic resources, thoughtfully made for future vets. Find BVSc & AH notes, books, objective questions and clinical references by year.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/index.md
- [BVSc Notes & Books](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/): Free notes, books and practical material for all four BVSc & AH professional years. Choose your year, then your subject.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/index.md
- [Veterinary Anatomy · 1st Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-1/veterinary-anatomy/): Veterinary Anatomy focuses on relating structure to function across domestic animal species. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Use labelled diagrams to compare the same structure between species, then explain its functional significance.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-1/veterinary-anatomy/index.md
- [Veterinary Physiology · 1st Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-1/veterinary-physiology/): Veterinary Physiology focuses on understanding how healthy animals maintain normal body functions. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Draw a process from stimulus to response before learning the individual hormones, transporters or feedback loops.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-1/veterinary-physiology/index.md
- [Livestock Production Management · 1st Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-1/livestock-production-management/): Livestock Production Management focuses on connecting animal husbandry principles with practical farm management. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Compare management requirements by species, age and production stage, with welfare and daily observation in view.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-1/livestock-production-management/index.md
- [1st Year BVSc Notes & Books](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-1/): Unit-wise notes and subject reading guides for 1st Year BVSc & AH. Choose a subject to find your next read.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-1/index.md
- [Veterinary Biochemistry · 2nd Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/veterinary-biochemistry/): Veterinary Biochemistry focuses on linking molecular processes with animal health and nutrition. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Build pathway maps around inputs, outputs and regulation instead of memorising disconnected reaction names.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/veterinary-biochemistry/index.md
- [Veterinary Microbiology · 2nd Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/veterinary-microbiology/): Veterinary Microbiology focuses on distinguishing infectious agents and the host responses they provoke. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Compare each agent by classification, transmission and laboratory identification while keeping species context clear.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/veterinary-microbiology/index.md
- [Veterinary Pathology · 2nd Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/veterinary-pathology/): Veterinary Pathology focuses on recognising mechanisms of disease and the lesions they produce. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Link the underlying mechanism to gross and microscopic changes, then practise describing lesions precisely.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/veterinary-pathology/index.md
- [Animal Genetics and Breeding · 2nd Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/animal-genetics-and-breeding/): Animal Genetics and Breeding focuses on applying inheritance and population principles to animal improvement. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Work through inheritance and selection examples step by step, checking assumptions before interpreting the result.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/animal-genetics-and-breeding/index.md
- [Animal Nutrition · 2nd Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/animal-nutrition/): Animal Nutrition focuses on understanding feeds, nutrient requirements and feeding systems. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Compare nutrient requirements with feed characteristics and production stage before attempting a balanced ration.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/animal-nutrition/index.md
- [2nd Year BVSc Notes & Books](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/): Unit-wise notes and subject reading guides for 2nd Year BVSc & AH. Choose a subject to find your next read.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/index.md
- [Veterinary Pharmacology and Toxicology · 3rd Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/veterinary-pharmacology-and-toxicology/): Veterinary Pharmacology and Toxicology focuses on connecting drug action with species, safety and clinical context. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Organise drug classes by mechanism, indications and adverse effects; verify clinical details against a current professional reference.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/veterinary-pharmacology-and-toxicology/index.md
- [Veterinary Parasitology · 3rd Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/veterinary-parasitology/): Veterinary Parasitology focuses on understanding parasite life cycles and their significance in animal health. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Sketch life cycles with hosts and infective stages, then connect those stages to diagnosis and prevention.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/veterinary-parasitology/index.md
- [Veterinary Public Health and Epidemiology · 3rd Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/veterinary-public-health-and-epidemiology/): Veterinary Public Health and Epidemiology focuses on connecting animal health, human health and population evidence. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Separate individual clinical findings from population measures, and state the denominator whenever interpreting disease frequency.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/veterinary-public-health-and-epidemiology/index.md
- [Livestock Products Technology · 3rd Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/livestock-products-technology/): Livestock Products Technology focuses on following animal products from production through processing and safety. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Use process flow diagrams to connect preservation methods, product quality and the purpose of each processing step.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/livestock-products-technology/index.md
- [Veterinary and Animal Husbandry Extension Education · 3rd Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/veterinary-and-animal-husbandry-extension-education/): Veterinary and Animal Husbandry Extension Education focuses on communicating animal husbandry knowledge in ways communities can use. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Match the communication method to the audience and explain how you would assess whether the advice was understood.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/veterinary-and-animal-husbandry-extension-education/index.md
- [Veterinary Clinical Practices I · 3rd Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/veterinary-clinical-practices-i/): Veterinary Clinical Practices I focuses on bringing foundational subjects into supervised clinical observation. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Practise clear histories and structured records under supervision, keeping observation separate from interpretation.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/veterinary-clinical-practices-i/index.md
- [Livestock Farm Practices · 3rd Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/livestock-farm-practices/): Livestock Farm Practices focuses on turning husbandry knowledge into supervised practical farm skills. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Keep brief observation notes that connect daily routines with animal welfare, production and the reasons behind management decisions.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/livestock-farm-practices/index.md
- [3rd Year BVSc Notes & Books](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/): Unit-wise notes and subject reading guides for 3rd Year BVSc & AH. Choose a subject to find your next read.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/index.md
- [Veterinary Medicine · 4th Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-4/veterinary-medicine/): Veterinary Medicine focuses on organising clinical reasoning around animal diseases and presenting problems. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Build problem lists before differential diagnoses, and compare diseases by distinguishing findings rather than isolated facts.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-4/veterinary-medicine/index.md
- [Veterinary Surgery and Radiology · 4th Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-4/veterinary-surgery-and-radiology/): Veterinary Surgery and Radiology focuses on understanding surgical principles alongside diagnostic imaging. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Connect anatomy, patient preparation and procedural reasoning; clinical techniques require supervised training and current guidance.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-4/veterinary-surgery-and-radiology/index.md
- [Veterinary Gynaecology and Obstetrics · 4th Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-4/veterinary-gynaecology-and-obstetrics/): Veterinary Gynaecology and Obstetrics focuses on understanding reproduction, fertility and obstetrical principles across species. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Compare reproductive timelines by species, then relate abnormal findings to the relevant stage and clinical history.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-4/veterinary-gynaecology-and-obstetrics/index.md
- [Veterinary Clinical Practices II · 4th Year](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-4/veterinary-clinical-practices-ii/): Veterinary Clinical Practices II focuses on integrating supervised clinical learning across the final professional year. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Present cases with a concise history, problem list and reasoned plan, and document what needs further confirmation.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-4/veterinary-clinical-practices-ii/index.md
- [4th Year BVSc Notes & Books](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-4/): Unit-wise notes and subject reading guides for 4th Year BVSc & AH. Choose a subject to find your next read.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-4/index.md

- [Objective Resources](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/objective/): Subject-wise objective questions and books for BVSc & AH revision. Find a focused question pack or check the availability of ICAR past papers.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/objective/index.md
- [Clinical Resources](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/clinical/): Veterinary handbooks and pharmacology notes for students preparing for clinical work. Start with a reference or explore Medicine, Surgery, Pathology and Pharmacology.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/clinical/index.md
- [Tips & Tools for Vet Study](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/study-tools/): Explore practical AI study guidance, useful free apps and everyday study tools for veterinary students. Use the guides to organise reading, references and presentations while checking veterinary information against trusted sources.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/study-tools/index.md
- [About Notes.ThatVetGuy](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/about/): Notes.ThatVetGuy is a free academic library for BVSc & AH students. Find notes, books and practical material by year, with study guides to help you choose what to read next.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/about/index.md
- [Request a Resource](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/request-resource/): Request a veterinary note, book, PYQ or useful study resource, or report a link that needs attention. Include the subject, year and source so the library can be improved for other veterinary students.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/request-resource/index.md
- [Best Books for 1st Year BVSc & AH](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-1/books/): A focused book list for 1st Year BVSc & AH, organised by subject. Start with one core text, then use a reference for difficult topics.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-1/books/index.md
- [Best Books for 2nd Year BVSc & AH](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/books/): A focused book list for 2nd Year BVSc & AH, organised by subject. Start with one core text, then use a reference for difficult topics.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-2/books/index.md
- [Best Books for 3rd Year BVSc & AH](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/books/): A focused book list for 3rd Year BVSc & AH, organised by subject. Start with one core text, then use a reference for difficult topics.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-3/books/index.md
- [Best Books for 4th Year BVSc & AH](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-4/books/): A focused book list for 4th Year BVSc & AH, organised by subject. Start with one core text, then use a reference for difficult topics.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/bvsc/year-4/books/index.md
- [Handbooks Collection](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/clinical/handbooks/): Veterinary handbook material in one place for BVSc & AH students. Check the original edition and use clinical references alongside supervised training.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/clinical/handbooks/index.md
- [Drug & Pharmacology Notes](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/clinical/drug-index/): Veterinary pharmacology notes arranged by topic for BVSc & AH study. These are learning notes, not a prescribing formulary or a substitute for current product information.
  - Markdown: https://notes.thatvetguy.net/clinical/drug-index/index.md
